QuestInfo.name: A Step Toward Home
QuestInfo.0: The cave fairy #b#p701##k in #m10006000# seems to have yet another request.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p701##k managed to restore her precious map, but the way home runs past fierce monsters. She asked me to defeat #r75 #o57#s#k and #r25 #o58#es#k west of the #m10006000# to make the path safer.
QuestInfo.2: As #p701# requested, I defeated #o57#s and #o58#es. Yet it felt as though monsters continued to pour out from deeper within the cave. What on earth could be happening inside?

0.0: Ah, welcome back! I imagine you're wondering whether I was able to restore my map? Thanks to you, I did, but... there's a bigger problem now.
0.1: Now that the map is whole, I can see the way home. But it runs right past the monsters west of the village, and they've grown more savage than I remember. A small fairy like me wouldn't get far...
0.2: Still, I don't want to give up yet. If you could defeat the monsters west of the #m10006000# and thin their numbers, perhaps the path home would become safe enough. Could you help me once more?

yes.0: Thank you so much! The #r#o57#s#k and #r#o58#es#k west of #m10006000# seemed especially dangerous. If you can defeat them, I promise I will find a way to repay you.

no.0: The #r#o57#s#k and #r#o58#es#k looked incredibly dangerous. I suppose even you might think it's too risky...

1.0: I was worried the whole time whether you would return safely. But it seems you've managed to defeat them all.
1.1: I was right to trust you. But if clearing just the first stretch took this much... I can't make it home alone. Someday I'll go back with a whole party of friends. Thank you, truly!

mob.0: Please defeat the #r#o57#s#k and #r#o58#es#k west of the village to make the path to my old home safer. I'm counting on you.
